assumptions.text: The audience values ongoing content and engagement with the show.
The speaker’s identity as host establishes legitimacy and continuity.
Subscribing and reviewing are meaningful actions that support the program's sustainability.
Acknowledging appreciation fosters goodwill and reinforces listener loyalty.
Listeners believe podcasts are trustworthy media for agricultural information.
Positive feedback like reviews strengthens community trust and encourages future production.
The audience has access to and uses podcast platforms, Facebook, and YouTube.
Audience members identify with the interests of Arkansas Farm Bureau and its mission.
Sponsorship by Arkansas Farm Bureau enhances the credibility of the content.
Regular release schedules build predictable audience habits.
